features.feature: Zero-finding documentation and decision-doc audit follows ordinary REVIEW default and does not require host verdict quorum
First REVIEW round threshold of at least two countable problems escalates to full 3x2 and missing quorum blocks DONE
Countable-problem filtering excludes suspected, disproven, non-reviewer, low severity, stale, duplicate, FAIL, and BLOCKED signals
features.source: CHK-001 edge/adversarial and CHK-002 smoke coverage

features.feature: Explicit degraded 3x1 fallback requires eligibility, allowed reason, evidence or approval, fresh material binding, and lower-assurance reporting
Direct decision-doc file-change always-on 3x2 trigger is removed from target DONE policy while decision-doc detection remains diagnostic
Operator-facing diagnostics avoid false always-on and Authority-completion claims
Gate-consumed review-escalation and verdict facts are registered in command policy, process-fact registry, levels, CLI surface, and verifier script
Implementation scope is bounded to PLAN touchpoints: core evaluator/gate, verdict event fields, CLI/handlers/registry, process-fact contract, smoke tasks, and the two decision docs
Authority Server implementation, remote push, unrelated branding, completed-story retrofits, and .omx usage
